name: Outdoor Research Alti II GORE-TEX mitts
summary: Modular winter mitts with a documented GORE-TEX shell and removable insulated liner. The Amazon product page requires a size selection and final variant confirmation.
description: This profile documents model 300009 from the manufacturer catalogue. The old product URL now redirects to a newer Alti model, so its specifications are not substituted here. The supplied black artwork does not establish the colour or size of either Amazon candidate.

pros: Removable liner supports drying between uses.
cons: Mitts trade individual finger dexterity for coverage.
